name: repo-watcher
summary: Watch .git and refresh: the app now tracks external reality
body:
The stale-status bug: the UI kept the state loaded at launch, so an
ism apply from a terminal left it showing files that no longer existed.
A debounced fs.watch on the active project's .git pushes repo:changed;
all git reads run with --no-optional-locks so our own refreshes never
trigger the watcher. Debouncer is unit-tested with fake timers.
